$comment: Retired product terms that shipped docs must not use. Read by scripts/check-docs-terms.mjs. `pattern` is a JavaScript regular expression (the `i` flag is added when `ignoreCase` is true). `allow` lists globs, relative to the repo root, of files where the term is legitimately historical. `use` says what to write instead.

terms.use: the local workspace CodeSense creates for you on this Mac
the current source path of the component, or no path at all
agents commit and push the context repo with git
teammates clone the context repo and connect it
the setup guide and the agent's MCP tools
an agent you define (a manager or controller is just an agent)

terms.term: panes as a product surface (pane packs, JSON widgets)
terms.use: an HTML pane in the team's panes/ folder, or a dashboard in the team repo
the context repo folder you cloned or created (CodeSense records where in ~/.codesense/users/<id>/context-attachments.yml)
a plain description of the step, not a local job-runner command
roles_list for configured settings; role_state for live registrations
